scripts.test: npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/make-shims.cjs && node --test ".test-out/src/**/__tests__/*.test.js"
scripts.test:coverage: npx tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/make-shims.cjs && npx c8 --reporter=text --reporter=lcov --include=".test-out/src/**/*.js" --exclude=".test-out/src/**/*.test.js" --exclude=".test-out/src/**/yomibakoBundle.js" --exclude=".test-out/src/**/browserBundle.js" --exclude=".test-out/src/features/shared/useWordAudio.js" --check-coverage --lines 85 --branches 85 --functions 85 node --test ".test-out/src/**/__tests__/*.test.js"
scripts.sonar:coverage: npm run test:coverage && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/sonar-scan.ps1
